title: Contracted GPU Allocation Matrix Q3 2026 (draft)
body:
Purpose: working allocation matrix for Dedicated customer contracts (per-contract snapshot + 3-month runway). This sheet combines currently reserved capacity, measured utilization, short-term projection, and recommended allocation adjustments. Status: draft — this is used to align infra + sales before commit amendments.

Column headings (CSV): ContractID, Customer, ContractStart, ContractEnd, RegionPrimary, RegionSecondary, GPUFamily, ReservedGPUs, HistoricalAvgUtilPct (last 30d), Peak30dGPUsUsed, ProjectedPeakNext90d, AllocationSlackGPUs, BufferPolicy, Notes, OnboardingWindow, SLALatencyTier, PenaltyClause

Rows:
C-1001, NovaMed, 2026-03-01, 2027-03-01, us-west1, us-east4, A100-40GB, 48, 62, 60, 56, -8, reserved for inference-rare spiky batches; suggest increase to 64 if rolling promos in Jun-Jul, 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-15, gold, SLA-PEN-1
C-1007, ShopFlow, 2026-02-15, 2026-08-14, eu-west1, eu-central1, H100-80GB, 128, 74, 115, 130, 2, committed burst policy allowed (burst to shared pool up to 10%); need confirm billing for burst, 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31, platinum, SLA-PEN-2
C-1012, LexaSearch, 2026-04-01, 2026-10-01, us-east4, us-west1, L4, 32, 45, 28, 30, -2, kv-cache heavy, recommend re-route prefixed queries to hotspot cache nodes, 2026-04-15 to 2026-05-15, silver, SLA-PEN-0
C-1020, FinSight, 2026-05-01, 2027-05-01, ap-southeast1, ap-northeast1, A100-40GB, 64, 88, 60, 85, 21, requires private deployment prep (VPC peering) before ramp; need HSM key exchange, 2026-05-20 to 2026-06-30, gold, SLA-PEN-3
C-1033, Tutorly, 2026-01-10, 2026-07-10, us-central1, us-east4, H100-80GB, 96, 54, 48, 60, -36, average underutilization overnight; propose time-based reclamation windows (02:00-08:00), 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14, silver, SLA-PEN-1
C-1041, VoxAssist, 2026-03-15, 2026-09-15, eu-central1, eu-west1, A100-40GB, 24, 92, 24, 36, 12, voice-transcription spikes tied to marketing events; hold additional 12 GPUs as buffer, 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-10, gold, SLA-PEN-2
C-1050, DataWorks, 2026-02-01, 2026-11-30, us-west1, ap-southeast1, L4, 40, 38, 16, 24, -16, batch embedding jobs scheduled nightly; can shift to cheaper pre-emptible in low-latency windows, 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-20, silver, SLA-PEN-0
C-1065, SecureGov, 2026-06-01, 2028-06-01, us-east4, us-west1, H100-80GB, 256, 96, 240, 260, 4, private deployment requested; dedicated isolation required (no shared burst). Hold physical racks and OS images ready, 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-01, platinum, SLA-PEN-5

Calculation notes:
- ProjectedPeakNext90d is based on linear ramp from last 30d trend + booked marketing/feature dates from Sales pipeline sheet.
- AllocationSlackGPUs = ReservedGPUs - ProjectedPeakNext90d. Negative numbers indicate shortfall -> recommend reallocation or short-term burst from shared pool.
- BufferPolicy: describes whether we keep buffer in same region, allow cross-region burst (cost+latency tradeoffs), or enforce strict isolation.

Region balance summary (current snapshot):
- us-west1: Reserved total = 216 GPUs (A100/L4 mix), Projected demand next 90d = 210, slack = +6
- us-east4: Reserved total = 368 GPUs (H100/A100), Projected demand next 90d = 390, slack = -22 (hotspot)
- eu-west1 + eu-central1 combined: Reserved = 248, Projected = 260, slack = -12
- ap-southeast1 + ap-northeast1 combined: Reserved = 320, Projected = 305, slack = +15

Risk flags (auto-generated):
- Contract C-1065 (SecureGov) requires physical rack commitment; if H100 supply shortage persists there is a 6-week delivery risk. -> Ops lead to confirm vendor ETA and alternate plan.
- us-east4 projected shortfall of -22 GPUs driven largely by ShopFlow (bursting) + FinSight ramp. Contingency: enable cross-region burst to us-west1 or enable short-term reserved from spot pool with SLA flag.
- Several contracts show negative AllocationSlackGPUs in the next 90d (C-1001, C-1012, C-1033, C-1050). These are prioritized by SLALatencyTier (platinum > gold > silver).

Proposed operational playbook (short):
1) Immediate (0-7 days):
   - Approve temporary cross-region burst policy for ShopFlow (C-1007) to borrow up to 10 GPUs from us-west1 during business hours. Owner: Tom Becker. Due: 2026-05-14.
   - Confirm H100 vendor delivery for SecureGov (C-1065). Owner: Miguel Ortega. Due: 2026-05-18.
2) Near term (7-30 days):
   - Apply time-based reclamation on Tutorly (C-1033) for 02:00-08:00 window; reclaim up to 20 GPUs for shared pool. Owner: Priya Desai. Due: 2026-05-25.
   - Sales to confirm upcoming NovaMed promo dates — if confirmed, pre-allocate additional 16 A100s in us-west1. Owner: Aisha Khan (coord with Sales). Due: 2026-05-20.
3) Medium term (30-90 days):
   - Re-evaluate commitment swaps: convert 32 L4 reserved (DataWorks) to cheaper pre-emptible profile during nightly windows. Owner: Eng-cost team (Han Li). Due: 2026-06-30.
   - Prepare private-deploy playbook for SecureGov including rack reservation checklist and HSM integration runbook. Owner: Platform Eng. Due: 2026-06-15.

Action items & open questions:
- Q1: How should we bill for cross-region burst in contracts that currently only list regionPrimary? (linked JIRA: JIRA-INS-1556)
- Q2: Can we provide firm guarantees for SecureGov without advanced hardware procurement timeline? (Sales + Legal)
- Q3: Does Finance want to amortize the cost of holding buffer GPUs for non-platinum customers? (Finance review required)

Appendix: short methodology + data sources:
- Usage telemetry: aggregated from infra-metrics pipeline (prometheus -> data-lake) — last 30d per-contract rolling average and 95p peak.
- Sales commitments: pulled from CRM (Salesforce) snapshot 2026-05-05.
- Vendor ETA: procurement sheet (internal).
- Definitions: ReservedGPUs = number of 1:1 guaranteed instances allocated to contract; ProjectedPeakNext90d = conservative 90-day peak projection; BufferPolicy values = [same-region, cross-region-burst, no-burst, private-only].

Notes to reviewers (quick):
- This sheet intentionally mixes capacity and operational recommendations; please flag if you prefer separated versions (pure accounting ledger vs operational playbook).
- Prioritize fixes for any contract with negative slack and SLALatencyTier >= gold.

History: created by Aisha Khan (capacity planner) — draft for infra+sales alignment meeting on 2026-05-12. Last updated with SecureGov contract details from procurement on 2026-05-11.
